encoded_size_calculator.description: function that computes an encoded output size from an input length; it must guard against signed integer overflow before doing arithmetic

input_length.description: field or variable holding the length of input data to be encoded, whose value may be arbitrarily large

max_input_size.description: macro or constant defining the maximum input length that can safely participate in encoded-size arithmetic without overflow

error_sentinel.description: sentinel return value used by a size calculator to signal an error or overflow condition
